pageHeader.subtitle: A community where women support women to learn, earn, and lead.

sections.title: The problem
sections.body:
Women often face extra barriers to training and career growth: time, cost, confidence, and access to role models. Programs that fit around their responsibilities are rare.

Women4women creates practical, supportive spaces for women to build skills together.

items.title: Skills workshops
items.description: Practical sessions on communication, digital skills, and personal finance.

items.title: Peer mentoring circles
items.description: Small groups where women share experience and hold each other accountable.

items.title: Entrepreneurship support
items.description: Guidance for women starting or growing small businesses.

sections.body: Members leave with new skills and, just as important, a network of women cheering them on.
